worked_solution:
The sum of the first $N$ terms of a geometric series can be determined by the formula

$$
{S}_{N}=\frac{{a}_{1}(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}.
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=8$ and $r=3.$ Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{S}_{N} & =\frac{8(1-{3}^{N})}{1-3} \\  & =-\frac{8}{2}(1-{3}^{N}) \\  & =4({3}^{N}-1).\end{aligned}
$$
